# game-icons.net icons used

Rendered at 256 px, white on transparent, from the SVG set (kept in `Chopper/SourceAssets/IconPacks/game-icons.net.svg`). The game tints them. License: CC BY 3.0, credit in `Assets/ThirdParty/CREDITS.md` and the game's Credits page.
